\hline \text { (C) } & \text { X-rays } S & \text { (III) } & 1 \mathrm{~mm} \text { to } 700 \mathrm{~nm} \\
\hline \text { (D) } & \text { Gamma rays } & \text { (IV) } & 1 \mathrm{~nm} \text { to } 10^{-3} \mathrm{~nm} \\

Given below are two statements :

Statement I : Electromagnetic waves are not deflected by electric and magnetic field.

Statement II : The amplitude of electric field and the magnetic field in electromagnetic waves are related to each other as E0=μ0ε0B0.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Statement I is true but statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is false but statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
